card.name: Words after a noun in instructions
card.fires_on: Words that follow a noun in dosing or preparation instructions, such as 'used', 'required', 'requiring', or the ending of 'Vaccinations' and 'Medications'. They come just before the instruction continues.

modes.label: Participle after noun
modes.description: A word like 'used' or 'required' right after a thing being handled or administered.
modes.example: Label all syringes and tubes<< used>> in this labeling procedure with the patient’s

modes.label: Ending of a section-heading word
modes.description: The last piece of a long plural noun in a numbered section heading.
modes.example: 2.1 Assessments, Medications, and Vacc<<inations>> Prior to First Dose of VELS

modes.label: Linking word in a clause
modes.description: A small word such as 'other', 'of' or 'are' that continues a noun phrase in instructions.
modes.example: Make all transfers<< of>> sodium pertechnetate Tc
